description: Transcribe a live stream (a live YouTube video or an HLS .m3u8 URL) while it runs. New lines arrive about every 30 seconds as progress notifications; the result is the full transcript with [stream time | UTC] stamps when the stream ends or maxMinutes pass. Default 10 minutes, at most 60. For recordings use get_transcript.

maxMinutes.description: Minutes to follow the stream. Default 10, capped at 60

url.description: Live YouTube URL or HLS (.m3u8) URL

name: watch_live
title: Watch a live stream
